profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer — AI/ML Platforms, Distributed Systems at Alteryx
profile.summary: I am a lifelong learner with a passion for software and open source principles.  I am a T-shaped nerd with a wide range of knowledge and a creative problem solver.  I am an independent self-starter, but I also immensely enjoy working within a team where I can share my knowledge, mentor and learn from others.  I create solutions with excellence and integrity.  When asked if I can think outside the box I answer, “There is no box.”

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Joined to help lead backend execution for a new AutoML product (no-code ML for analysts), focusing on reliability, latency, and orchestration on Kubernetes (AWS).

• Cluster operations & actors — Operated and tuned a distributed systems backend built on Akka (later Apache Pekko) for ML job orchestration. Refactored and implemented actors, optimized cluster-singleton schedulers, and improved resiliency under load.
• Workload classification & QoS — Defined batch vs. interactive job classes with reserved cluster capacity, preventing head-of-line blocking and preserving low-latency UI responsiveness during saturation.
• Warm worker pool (lead) — Co-designed and led implementation of an idle Python worker pool, replacing per-job pod creation and cutting interactive latency from ~12–20 s to ~3 s.
• GPU execution path — Led GPU enablement with CUDA-enabled images, taints/tolerations, node selection, and driver/toolkit alignment, improving cost/perf efficiency.
• Platform migrations — Guided services through major infra transitions (single-tenant → multi-tenant EKS, auth, operational constraints) while maintaining stability and performance. Instrumented and tuned Datadog dashboards.
• Product integration — Delivered backend components for the Alteryx Designer AutoML tool, enabling secure interaction between the desktop client, cloud APIs, authentication, and the AutoML web UI.
• Mentorship & technical leadership — Provided ongoing mentorship through code reviews and pair programming with junior engineers, guiding Scala language use, SQL optimization, Kubernetes operations, and testing strategies.

Stack: Scala • Akka / Apache Pekko • Kubernetes (EKS) • AWS • Docker • Datadog • React (integration) • CUDA / GPU

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior engineer for Gaia’s architectural transformation to the cloud and containerized microservices.  Contributed to strategic technical direction by collaborating across teams and disciplines, and made recommendations to support scaling from 200k to 700k subscribers.  Worked with stakeholders to understand requirements and design solutions for new features. Delivered features and mentored new team members as part of a cross-functional Agile team.  Created video recommender system for personalization.

Implemented collaborative filtering model in R, fast real-time inference API in Node.js, and data pipelines with Kafka, AWS Kinesis and Lambda. Developed front and backend features in Node.js, React/Redux, PostgreSQL and Redis.  Some exposure to data lakes with Spark, Hive, Presto, Apache Airflow, and machine learning with XGBoost, Keras and Tensorflow.

positions.title: Lead Drupal Developer
positions.description: Architect and lead developer of GaiamTV video streaming website (later renamed Gaia).  Led Scrum team and mentored junior developers.  Created API for apps and won Brightcove Innovation Award for Roku app.  Scaled from zero to 200,000 subscribers.  Integrated multiple third party video platforms, payment processing providers and search engines.  Created video ingest tools, royalties and rights management and video analytics solutions. Led six major data migrations.

company.name: Waterstone Environmental Hydrology and Engineering, Inc.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Installed and configured GIS platform for securely serving shapefile data and raster map tiles using Minnesota MapServer, PostGIS, GDAL/OGR, Proj.4 and other open source tools.  Developed authentication and authorization API in PHP to control geographic access to GIS system.  Configured servers with DoD root CA certificates and required users to authenticate over SSL using X.509 certificates on DoD Common Access Card (CAC) ID smart cards.

positions.title: IT Systems Administrator
positions.description: Responsible for all aspects of IT including system administration, hardware maintenance, network, firewalls, DNS, LDAP, Exim mail server, data backup with Bacula, desktop support, database administration and source code repository. Secured servers for DoD DITSCAP/DIACAP certification.

positions.title: System Test Technician
positions.description: Built and tested large flash memory test systems. Diagnosed electrical, mechanical and software failures. Developed numerous tools and scripts to facilitate debugging of test data and inventory control.

positions.title: Electronic Assembler
positions.description: Diagnosed and repaired failed printed circuit board assemblies after In Circuit Test (ICT); inspection and soldering per IPC A-610 standard, class 2 thru-hole and surface mount (PTH / SMT), including fine pitch and extra fine pitch; operated Hewlett-Packard (HP) 3070.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description: Provided telephone customer service for HP tape drives and CD writers.  These were the good old days of buffer underruns and external drives connected via printer parallel port.
